notes: Official 2026 USMLE Skin outline explicitly lists staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome.
SSSS StatPearls last updated June 22, 2025 in the 2026 edition; exfoliative toxin A/B cleavage of desmoglein-1 and superficial epidermal separation directly supported.

duplicate_gate.selected_construct: SSSS exfoliative toxin cleavage of desmoglein-1

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Young child with tender erythema, superficial flaccid bullae, Nikolsky positivity and mucosal sparing has systemic S aureus exfoliative-toxin injury to desmoglein-1.
adversarial_second_pass.pemphigus_attack: Pemphigus vulgaris targets desmoglein-3 and commonly involves mucosa with deeper suprabasal acantholysis.
adversarial_second_pass.pemphigoid_attack: BP180 autoimmunity causes tense subepidermal bullae in a different demographic.
adversarial_second_pass.other_distractors: Dermatitis herpetiformis and collagen-VII defects have different immunopathology/cleavage planes.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: S aureus culture establishes infectious context but the tested answer is the molecular adhesion target.
